# dev-marketplace

The plugins the Acme engineering department installs

Owner: Acme

## Add this marketplace

### Claude Code

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/acme/index.git
claude plugin install <plugin>@dev-marketplace
```

### GitHub Copilot

```sh
copilot plugin marketplace add https://github.com/acme/index.git
copilot plugin install <plugin>@dev-marketplace
```

### Codex

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/acme/index.git
codex plugin add <plugin>@dev-marketplace
```

### Qoder

```sh
qoder plugins marketplace add https://github.com/acme/index.git
qoder plugins install <plugin>
```

## Plugins

| Plugin | Description | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `hex` | Tiered multi-agent swarm orchestration: plan, execute, review, architect | 0.0.0 |
| `review-kit` | Review a diff against the team checklist and keep Rust idiomatic | 0.0.0 |

## Private repositories

Each client clones this repository with the machine's own `git`, so a private repository works when that machine has a git credential helper or an SSH agent that can read it. See [Use a plugin marketplace without grim](https://grimoire.rs/guides/use-a-marketplace.html#private-repositories) for what each client documents.

Packaged by grim (https://grimoire.rs); install grim for pinned, updatable installs.
